name: GreenPrint
tagline: A hub for IoT sensors with agent workflows that email alerts, for example when CO2 gets dangerous.
problem: Sustainability and safety data from sensors is scattered and passive.
solution: Register a hub, link IoT data sources, view readings live and configure agent workflows that act and email when conditions trigger.
demo_moment: Team-described: CO2 rises and an alert email arrives.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Best Use of AgentMail API” among 122 submissions.

lessons: Agents add value when they act on sensor thresholds.
